tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search 135,457+ live, scam-filtered remote jobs (updated hourly). Natural-language queries OK (hybrid semantic search). Returns title, company, location, salary when disclosed, posted date, an employer apply_url, and a canonical detail_url to link back to.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch one job in full (description included) by the 8-hex id that appears at the end of a detail_url.

tools.name: job_facets
tools.description: Counts by source, category, country and tag across the live index — call this first to learn what filters are useful.
